title: GONG Multi-Channel Data for Solar Filaments
subtitle: GONG H-alpha frames 2023-2025 and bzi magnetograms matched to MAGFiLO 1.0

resources.description: Burst groups of the H-alpha frames (5 frames, offsets -4..+4 min) and counts of rejected frames by reason.
Match status of every MAGFiLO 1.0 training observation to a same-site bzi magnetogram: time gap (min), plage correlation, status ok / too far / no frames.

userSpecifiedSources:
GONG H-alpha full-disk frames (haf, FITS), NSO Integrated Synoptic Program: https://gong2.nso.edu/HA/haf/ ; converted with the MLEcoFi FITS-to-JPEG convertor: https://bitbucket.org/dataresearchlab/mleco-fits2jpegconvertor
GONG line-of-sight magnetograms (bzi): https://nispdata.nso.edu/ftp/vmb/archive/bzi/
Matching targets: MAGFiLO 1.0 training observation times (Kaggle solar filament segmentation challenge 2026); no MAGFiLO images or annotations included.
